_meta.scope: Simulation / code / bookkeeping checks on the existing PathSolver shard corpus. No comparison against RF measurements. Levels are PathSolver level in dB (arbitrary reference), not RCS. Hovering drone, one range, no thermal noise, single-antenna sum field: no detection probability, range, angle or tracking accuracy can be computed from it.

seeds.dropout_seed_rule: np.random.default_rng([DROPOUT_SEED, h, k]); h = int(sha256(f'{arm}_el{el:+g}')[:12], 16) of the cell the draw is for; k = 0..4 random-control pose sets, k = 10..14 random blade-phase / adjacency pose sets

definitions.comb_contrast_db: Merged E over all poses (shards scattered back by idx, never concatenated); P = |FFT(E - mean E)|^2 / n^2 with a rectangular window; PRF from shard meta[4]; comb bins = harmonics 1..12 of FFL at +/- frequency, +/-2 bins each (bin index round(h*FFL/df)); non-comb bins = all other bins except DC; contrast = 10log10(mean comb-bin power / mean non-comb-bin power).
definitions.static_db: 10log10(|mean E|^2), PathSolver level in dB (arbitrary reference).
definitions.comb_bin_mean_db / noncomb_bin_mean_db: 10log10 of the mean of P over comb / non-comb bins (P as above).
definitions.variant hann: Hann window (np.hanning(n)) applied to E - mean E before the FFT; masks unchanged.
definitions.variant hw1 / hw3: comb half-width +/-1 or +/-3 bins instead of +/-2.
definitions.variant bandlimited_floor: non-comb bins restricted to |f| <= (12 + 0.5) * FFL; comb mask unchanged.
definitions.knob delta: variant contrast minus primary contrast for the same row, over every row.
definitions.ground_like_max_contrast_db: max over the primary metric and all six variants, over every iso row (all drone heights) in outdoor01_ground, outdoor01 and street_canyon.
definitions.ground_like_max_contrast_default_height_: the same max restricted to iso rows at the default drone height (no env_alt tag).
definitions.free_sky_min_contrast_db: min over the primary metric and all six variants, over iso free_sky rows.
definitions.repeat rel_rms_change: sqrt(mean|E_rep - E_base|^2 / mean|E_base - mean E_base|^2), same poses.
definitions.repeat contrast_spread_db: max - min primary contrast among the base run and its rep runs.
definitions.ground_floor field: D = E(outdoor01_ground, iso) - E(free_sky, iso), same arm otherwise, same poses.
definitions.flatness: spectral flatness of D - mean D over non-DC bins: exp(mean log P) / mean P.
definitions.top1pct_share: share of the non-DC power held by the largest 1 % of non-DC bins (n_bins // 100).
definitions.white_ref: the same two statistics for one complex Gaussian draw of the same length (seed rule in _meta.seeds).
definitions.dwell window: the first N poses in time order (pose index = time index), same metric with df = PRF/N.
definitions.comb_bins_fraction: fraction of all bins that the comb mask covers at that window length.
definitions.antenna deltas: ant cell minus its iso control (same scene, build, depth, el, env_alt): total, static, varying levels; noncomb_delta_db / comb_delta_db = ratio of mean non-comb / comb bin power.
definitions.ant_minus_free_sky: scene_total_minus_free_sky_*_db = total_db(scene cell) - total_db(free_sky cell) for the same antenna setting, build, depth and el.
definitions.clutter_limited: 10log10(mean comb-bin power of the free_sky cell / mean non-comb-bin power of the scene cell), same antenna setting, build, depth, el and n.
definitions.radar_height_above_ground_m: env_alt_m + range_m*sin(el) for outdoor01* scenes (repo_quotes radar_height_note); null for free_sky and street_canyon.
definitions.env_alt_m: _alt tag value if present; else outdoor01* default alt_m (repo_quotes default_env_alt); street_canyon: ENV_BUILTIN_ALT, the drone offset above the scene origin (repo_quotes builtin_scene_alt), not a height above local ground; free_sky: null.
definitions.n_poses_at_path_limit: poses with nret >= 0.99 x path limit (n_trunc[1] when stored, else the default MAX_PATHS); null when the shard has no nret.
definitions.queued cell status: landed_complete = a complete production cell with the same parsed fields exists at the queue build (the build tag of the landed antenna cells); landed_incomplete = shards exist but the cell is incomplete; not_landed = no shard. only_in_superseded_files = every job line for the cell sits in a file whose first line says SUPERSEDED.
definitions.spectra npz psd_db: 10log10 of P = |FFT(E - mean E)|^2 / n^2 per bin, rectangular window, fftshifted, one common absolute reference for all series (the PathSolver arbitrary level reference; the bins of one series sum to its varying power). DC bin stored as NaN.
definitions.dropout complex median: m = median(Re E) + 1j*median(Im E) over all poses of the merged cell (component-wise).
definitions.dropout outlier poses (factor k): poses with |E - m| > k * median_over_poses(|E - m|); k in [10, 20, 50], primary k = 20. A statistical label on the stored field, not a statement about the solver.
definitions.dropout varying_power_share_of_outliers: sum over outlier poses of |E - mean E|^2 / sum over all poses of |E - mean E|^2 (primary factor). The _median_ref variant uses |E - m|^2 in both sums.
definitions.dropout abs_ratio_to_median: |E| / |m| at each outlier pose; min, median and max over the outlier poses.
definitions.dropout n_outliers_abs_ratio_above_0p5: number of outlier poses (primary factor) with |E| / |m| > 0.5.
definitions.dropout abs_dev_over_abs_median_median: median over the outlier poses of |E - m| / |m|.
definitions.dropout dev_gap_ratio: min over outlier poses of |E - m| / max over non-outlier poses of |E - m| (primary factor); above 1 by construction, large when the outliers stand far from the bulk.
definitions.dropout comb_contrast_db_outliers_replac: comb_contrast_db (same definition) of E with the outlier poses (factor as named) set to m; _f10 / _f50 use the other factors.
definitions.dropout random_control: 5 draws (seed rule _meta.seeds.dropout_seed_rule): the same number of poses drawn without replacement from the non-outlier poses (primary factor) set to m; comb contrast min / max over the draws.
definitions.dropout runs: maximal runs of consecutive pose indices inside the outlier set (index order = time order, not wrapped); n_runs and the longest run length.
definitions.dropout adjacent_fraction: fraction of outlier poses with another outlier pose at index +/-1 (nearest outlier neighbour 1 pose away); null when fewer than 2 outliers. The random counterpart is the max of the same fraction over 5 random pose sets of equal size drawn from all poses.
definitions.dropout blade_phase_R: Rayleigh mean resultant length |mean exp(1j*2*pi*h*FFL*idx/PRF)| over the outlier poses, h = 1 (FFL = constants.ffl_hz, idx = pose index, PRF from shard meta). random_R_max = max of the same R over 5 random pose sets of equal size drawn from all poses. _max_h1_12 = max over h = 1..12 of R, with the random counterpart taking the same max per set. Null when no outlier.
definitions.dropout rayleigh_p_approx: exp(-n R^2) for n outlier poses at h = 1 (large-n Rayleigh-test approximation).
definitions.dropout jaccard: |A intersect B| / |A union B| of two outlier pose-index sets (primary factor); null when both sets are empty.
definitions.dropout repeat_jaccard: over the base run and its rep runs (the groups of repeats.groups), every pair of runs; min and max over pairs.
definitions.dropout cross_build_jaccard: between the 2.0.1 row and the 2.1.0 row matched on every arm field except the solver build tag, same el (the canyon_build_change pairing rule); stored on both rows of the pair.
definitions.dropout E_dedup: when every shard of the cell stores E_dedup (the sum that counts identical path entries once; see benchmark/elevation_sweep_md.py), the same outlier count and replaced contrast computed on E_dedup with its own complex median; jaccard_with_E compares its outlier set with the E outlier set.
definitions.dropout npaths_median_ratio: median npaths over outlier poses / median npaths over all poses, when every shard stores npaths.
definitions.dropout summary: dropout.summary groups every row by (scene, ant); summary_by_build_depth by (scene, ant, build, depth). *_min / *_max are over the cells of the group (null entries skipped); random_control_contrast_max_db = max over cells of the per-cell random-control max; n_cells_R_above_random_max counts cells whose outlier R exceeds that cell's random_R_max.

hover.definition: position_fixed is true when every assignment to the scene centre _ctr inside run() is a tuple of numeric constants (or the build_scene_builtin return whose ctr is such a tuple) and every place() call in run() uses center=_ctr, so the drone position does not depend on the pose.

dropout.scope: every row of rows[] (all scenes, antennas, builds, depths, heights; el window, munich and env_scat excluded as in rows); repeat and cross-build overlaps use the rep cells and matched rows.
